# Android app: photo reserve and QR code for the server address
### New
- **Android app 1.5.0 – photo reserve.** If the network or the server goes down, the frame keeps showing photos it has already seen (up to 150 are stored on the device) instead of an error page, even after an app restart and even without HTTPS. The frame page, its settings and the always-on photo list are remembered for this. Photos come from the device first (a photo never changes), everything else from the network first. Also applies to the screensaver.
- **Android app 1.5.0 – find the server with a QR code.** In the menu (long-press the picture) and on the search screen there is "QR-Code scannen". This is the way for a tablet in another network (for example at your parents'), where searching the home network finds nothing. The app checks the scanned address before saving it. Android asks for the camera permission the first time; devices without a camera (many TVs) do not show the entry.
- **"Add device" shows a QR code with the server address** (editable, for example to the address from outside) that the app scans.
### Changed
- The app menu has been rebuilt; "QR-Code scannen" is new. The tablet check reports devices with an older app as outdated until the update (app 1.5.0) has been confirmed once.

Update: `cd ~/immich-showcase && docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`. The Android app updates itself from the tablet check or the app menu. ☕ [ko-fi.com/frameside](https://ko-fi.com/frameside)
